items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: the music store was owned by Mr. Armandon and his wife, and he would sell me a base drum head for $3.

ctx.x: Well, there was a guy that used to come there every other Saturday -- he would come, and as soon as he would get drunk, the first thing he'd do was come up to the bandstand and knock a hole in my base drum. And I used to get so mad, but I had to smile because back in those days, you had better smile, so I smiled, but I didn't like it too well.

But then he would give me $5. Well, at that time, drums heads, you had to buy them loose -- they wasn't already tucked on to the drum, and so I was able to go to the music store down there on Flagley Street -- the music store was owned by Mr. Armandon and his wife, and he would sell me a base drum head for $3. So I used to make $2 on the deal every other week.
